zh-CN.name: AI 原生 UI
zh-CN.description: 围绕 AI 的不确定输出、用户输入、校验和修正关系设计的交互方向。它不是在普通界面中添加聊天框，也不能以“AI 原生”暗示所有建议都准确或所有行动都已完成。
use_when: AI 能力是任务核心且输出需要用户检查。
产品能够区分生成、验证和执行阶段。
avoid_when: 不能用流畅文本伪装为已经验证的事实。
模型建议不应默认直接执行重要外部操作。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
围绕输入、生成、检查与修正组织任务，显示来源、限制与实际执行状态；提供可编辑结果、撤销与非AI替代路径；必要动作由用户确认，不把建议当作已执行结果。
专属演示：输入、模拟建议、人工编辑和确认的独立状态，不调用模型，不把建议当作已执行。 参数：演示时长 {duration_ms}ms。

en.name: AI-Native UI
en.description: An interaction direction designed around uncertain AI output, user input, validation and correction. It is not merely a chat box added to an ordinary interface, and the label does not imply that every suggestion is correct or every action is complete.
use_when: AI capabilities are central to the task and outputs need user review.
The product can distinguish generation, validation and execution.
avoid_when: Do not present fluent text as automatically verified fact.
Model suggestions should not automatically execute consequential external actions.
en.prompt_template:
Organize the task around input, generation, review and correction. Show provenance, limitations and actual execution state. Offer editable results, undo and non-AI alternatives; require confirmation where needed and distinguish suggestions from executed outcomes.
Dedicated demonstration: Separate input, simulated suggestion, human edit and confirmation states; no model call and no suggestion presented as an executed action. Parameters: demo duration {duration_ms}ms.
